draft.personalized_ask: Would you be willing to critique whether this is a useful architectural account of delegated agency, and whether it could become a doctoral question in your research group?
draft.body:
Dear Professor Paek,

Your PNU profile explicitly links AI architecture with posthumanism and everyday life, and lists your 2023 study of AI as a facade object (https://his.pusan.ac.kr/pnuProfl/archi/551/23126/artclView.do).

Proxy Society asks what happens when an AI representative acts for an absent person. I would compare a speaking position at a shared civic counter with a separate screened niche, using the same voice and mandate. The question is whether the room makes authority, responsibility and the option to return personally intelligible, rather than treating presence as an audio effect.

Would you be willing to critique whether this is a useful architectural account of delegated agency, and whether it could become a doctoral question in your research group?

Best regards,
Kris Haamer

coordination_groups.instruction: Start with one architectural/theory question: Paek for agency, Jin for reversible thresholds, Han for regeneration, or Woo for public-space links. Select a complementary method after fit is clearer; avoid sending eight parallel copies to one department.
Roh for access, Hong for publicness, Lee for evidence and perception. Choose one lead question before a second approach; the shared department and doctorate are not three independent offers.
Sung for adaptive reuse and governance; Lee for the street/building boundary. Confirm target-degree and language procedure separately.
Conservation, community operation and spatial accessibility are distinct questions in an urban/planning degree context. Avoid treating these as an interchangeable Architecture-supervisor list.

Use one supported project as the critique prompt. All selected emails are practice-office routes; dual-city bases and project proposals are explicit. Ask before assuming personal presence or project access.
KIAB and KIRA are distinct organisations. Ask one for a relevant named professional route; the phone script is prepared only and no call has been made.
